entries.clue: Dependant in the family was the soul of discretion (4,3)

entries.clue: Born tilted, is cant originally stopping device? (5,4)

indicatorNotes.originally: what something is originally is how it starts, so take the first letter of cant

blocks.note: b = born
a raked stage is tilted
as written
first letter of cant

annotation.surface: A question whether a baby's tilted position is a way to stop something.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Cant' also means tilt, so it seems to continue 'tilted', but it only gives its first letter.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: this rotor part of a car's brakes is a device for stopping.

entries.clue: Paediatrician’s preserve probing unusual pink bonces? (8,5)

indicatorNotes.probing: a probe goes into something, so JAM goes into the rearranged letters
indicatorNotes.unusual: unusual means out of the normal, so PINK BONCES is rearranged

blocks.note: jam is a fruit preserve
PINK BONCES rearranged, with JAM going in; bonce is British slang for head

annotation.surface: A children's doctor's instrument probing odd-coloured heads.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Preserve' reads as a doctor's special area, but it is jam, and the 's is 'is'.
annotation.definitionFit: The American doctor whose book on baby care was a bestseller was a famous paediatrician.

entries.clue: Bladed weapon cut skin on back of knee (4)

indicatorNotes.cut: something cut is trimmed, so PEEL loses its last letter
indicatorNotes.on: in an across clue, one thing on another comes after it
indicatorNotes.back of: the back of a word is its last letter, so knee gives E

blocks.note: last letter of knee
PEEL, skin, with its end cut off

annotation.surface: A sword wound to the skin behind someone's knee.
annotation.walkthrough: The fencing surface makes 'cut' a wound, but it trims a word.
annotation.definitionFit: The fencing sword has a blade, so it is a bladed weapon.

entries.clue: Republican put in application after party conference (9)

indicatorNotes.put in: to put something in is to insert it, so R goes inside USE
indicatorNotes.after: what comes after follows, so USE with R comes after DISCO

blocks.note: a disco is a party
the application of something is its use
R = Republican

annotation.surface: A Republican applying to speak after a party conference.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Party conference' reads as one political event, but the two words split into wordplay and definition.
annotation.definitionFit: An old sense: discourse is talk or conversation, which conference also once meant.

entries.clue: Bird seed catching salmon (7)

indicatorNotes.catching: one thing catching another holds it, so SOW holds PARR

blocks.note: a parr is a young salmon
to seed a field is to sow it

annotation.surface: A bird with a seed catching a fish.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Bird seed' reads as one phrase, but 'Bird' alone is the definition and seed is a verb.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the small brown finch-like bird.
